description: Scala class implementing a key-value writer for Spark shuffle, specifically for writing partitioned key-value pairs to an output stream with optional checksum support.

classes.name: ShufflePartitionPairsWriter
classes.description: A key-value writer that pushes bytes to a partition writer instead of local disk, with checksum support.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the output stream, initializing the stream if necessary.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the output streams and serializer for writing.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all streams safely, updating the bytes written metrics.

methods.name: closeIfNonNull
methods.description: Closes a stream if it is not null.

methods.name: recordWritten
methods.description: Updates metrics after a record is written.

methods.name: updateBytesWritten
methods.description: Updates the byte count metrics based on the partition writer.
